description: High-level recipe search. Accepts food/keyword/book *names* (not IDs) and resolves them internally, typically collapsing 3-4 round-trips into 1. Example: {foods: ["chicken", "broccoli"], exclude_foods: ["peanuts"], keywords: ["weeknight"]}. For complex ID-based filtering, fall back to list_recipes.

books.description: Recipe book names; recipe must be in ANY of these

exclude_foods.description: Food names the recipe must NOT contain any of

foods.description: Food names the recipe must contain ALL of

keywords.description: Keyword names; recipe must have ANY of these

makenow.description: Only recipes makeable with currently on-hand foods

name: search_recipes
title: Search recipes
